title: 服装玩具奶茶出海开店：龙头在艰难行业仍跑赢，谁在海外抢到份额？
speaker: Michelle Cheng

segments.en: So if you look at the from the company's level, even the tough sector, actually, market leaders still perform much better.
segments.zh: 所以从公司层面看，即使在艰难的行业，市场龙头实际上表现仍好得多。

segments.en: But of course, I think from the sector perspective, we like some sectors, either they have secret growth opportunities, for example, like YGOOs, domestic businesses, it's more stabilized, but they have going global story.
segments.zh: 当然，从行业角度看，我们喜欢一些行业，要么有增长机会，比如部分公司国内业务更稳定，但有出海故事。

segments.en: And also, you have restaurants, the sector is slow, but you have market leaders, they are getting shares. And also, others exact theory, they have cyclical rebounds.
segments.zh: 还有餐饮，行业增长慢，但市场龙头在抢份额。还有一些行业有周期性反弹。

segments.en: So we do still have some sectors delivering relatively decent growth with a good return. Where does it leave F&B names?
segments.zh: 所以我们仍有一些行业实现相对不错的增长和良好回报。那食品饮料公司呢？

segments.en: As you mentioned, you know, for you to stand out, you need to have a going global theme. So just like, as an example, Heidi Lau, for example, some of the bubble tea names, where do these stack within your reference?
segments.zh: 正如你提到的，要脱颖而出，需要有出海主题。比如一些奶茶公司，这些在你的框架里如何排序？

segments.en: Yeah, so that's a great point. If we compare this cushionary versus stable F&B, this cushionary is easier to have some going global story. So YGOOs, even apparel, or the toy companies, bubble teas in between, yeah, we are actually seeing more companies, open stores in US, in Korea, in Asian countries.
segments.zh: 是的，这是个好观点。如果比较可选消费和必需食品饮料，可选消费更容易有出海故事。所以部分公司、服装、玩具公司，奶茶介于中间，我们确实看到更多公司在美国、韩国、亚洲国家开店。

segments.en: But overall, F&B companies, probably still more domestic driven, and even more pricing driven. So the domestic economy and inflation, I think, is still the critical catalyst for the F&B companies.
segments.zh: 但总体而言，食品饮料公司可能仍更多由国内驱动，甚至更多由价格驱动。所以国内经济和通胀，我认为仍是食品饮料公司的关键催化剂。

segments.en: I want to give you a question, that was a big one this week. I mean, you're initiating as a buy right now, you are seeing that earnings are going to rebound. What are you seeing in terms of the turnaround of this company?
segments.zh: 我想问你一个问题，这是本周的大问题。我的意思是，你现在给出买入评级，你看到盈利将会反弹。你看到这家公司转机体现在哪里？

segments.en: I mean, the earnings are pretty bad when they report it here. Yeah. So I guess on the one side, one is, it's actually fitting into a thing we like a lot, going global. This is actually the one of the early names, they prove they're going global stories.
segments.zh: 我的意思是，他们这次报告的盈利相当差。是的。所以一方面，它实际上符合我们非常喜欢的主题，出海。这实际上是最早证明出海故事的公司之一。
